title: Employee Spotlight: Shamit Patel, Vice President, Product
summary: Our Employee Spotlight series highlights members of our team, like Shamit Patel, to provide a glimpse into Instawork culture.
body_markdown:
Our mission at Instawork is to create economic opportunities for local businesses and professionals, globally. In order to achieve that mission, we have built a team composed of talented and hard-working individuals who are passionate about connecting skilled hourly professionals with local businesses who need their services, including those in temp staffing and workers in San Marcos | Instawork and temp staffing in Orange.


Our *Employee Spotlight* series takes the opportunity to highlight members of our team and to give a glimpse into our culture and what it's like to work at Instawork. To highlight the diversity of our team, we've asked[shamit patel](https://www.instawork.com/blog/shamit-patel-vp-product-management) , Vice President of Product, to share more about his experience working at Instawork.


### What do you do at Instawork and how long have you been with the company?


I have been with Instawork since early 2021, leading the product and design teams to ensure the best mobile/web application experiences for our Professionals, Partners, and internal users.


### What initially attracted you to Instawork?


It almost sounds like too much of a coincidence, but two of my mentors asked me to talk to Sumir (our CEO and Co-founder), when I mentioned I was starting to look at new opportunities.


When I met with Sumir, we discussed the company values and why he chose to start Instawork. It became clear pretty quickly that my personal values were inline with Sumir's. I was also excited about Instawork's mission and the impact we could have in creating economic opportunities for both our Partners and Pros.


### What's your favorite part of your job?


I get to work with exceptional people who are humble, smart, hard-working, and are always looking to learn. We have developed some great product features and have already seen the impact they have on our users' experience.


### **** What is one piece of "work from home" equipment you couldn't live without?


My white board, which I use for brainstorming.


### What's the most important thing you've learned since starting at Instawork?


"Intellectual honesty" is a term that has come up every now and then that asks you to think about how you can really introspect to find the root cause of a problem. Everyone needs to look in the mirror on occasion and reflect to successfully find a solution to the problem ahead of you.


### In 10 words or less, how would you describe the culture at Instawork?


Focused, empathic, hard-working, data-driven, resourceful, and smart.


If you're interested in joining Instawork and working alongside team members like Shamit, visit our[Careers page](https://info.instawork.com/careers) to view current job opportunities.
